events.title: Five rest days in Tarifa
events.summary: Alice and I stayed five days in Tarifa, which gave me a real chance to relax before crossing to Morocco. Afterwards my body felt fresh again.
events.quote: We ended up staying five days in Tarifa, which was very nice

events.title: Night at the observatory
events.summary: On our first night in Tarifa, Alice and I slept at the observatory. I recorded my previous diary entry there.
events.quote: the first night we stayed at the observatory

events.title: Couchsurfing with Jersey
events.summary: On our second night in Tarifa, Alice and I stayed with a Couchsurfing host called Jersey.
events.quote: staying  with a couch surfing guy called Jersey
